Project.title: Project
Project.description: A portfolio project or digital product managed by the admin and displayed publicly.

name.description: Display name of the project or product.

url.description: Optional HTTPS live demo or product URL.

description.description: Short summary describing the project or product.

screenshot.description: Uploaded compressed image data URL or external HTTPS image URL.

category.description: Category label such as AI Web Tool, E-Commerce, or Product.

technologies.description: List of up to 12 technologies or tags.

isPublished.description: Whether the project or product is publicly visible.

ownerId.description: Authenticated admin UID who created the record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized administrator role document mapped by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin entry was registered.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Publicly readable portfolio projects and products, writable only by verified admins.
